title: 纽约马拉松冠军阿尔姆格伦首秀夺冠
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We're here with the winner of the 2026 New York City Marathon, Andreas Omgren.
segments.zh: 我们在这里采访2026年纽约马拉松冠军安德烈亚斯·奥姆格伦。

segments.en: First of all, congratulations on the spectacular performance. Thank you very much.
segments.zh: 首先，恭喜你取得如此出色的成绩。非常感谢。

segments.en: And as you're running this race, I wonder from your perspective, when did you realize you could win it?
segments.zh: 当你跑这场比赛时，我想从你的角度问，你什么时候意识到自己能赢？

segments.en: Was it from the beginning, the middle, the end? No, I'd say when I actually started thinking about winning, it was with about five kilometers left.
segments.zh: 是从一开始、中途还是最后？不，我说我开始想赢的时候，大概还剩五公里。

segments.en: Wow. I mean, this is my first marathon, so I didn't really know how I was supposed to feel during the different stages with five kilometers left.
segments.zh: 哇。我是说，这是我的第一场马拉松，所以我不太知道在还剩五公里的不同阶段应该是什么感觉。

segments.en: I felt like, OK, I have a lot of energy.
segments.zh: 我感觉，好，我还有很多能量。

segments.en: And the other guys started to do these surges and attacks. And it's quite easy to respond to this.
segments.zh: 其他人开始加速和进攻。而应对这个还挺容易的。

segments.en: So talk to me about strategy in running. We hear a lot about a lot of people who are just participants in doing this for fun.
segments.zh: 跟我谈谈跑步策略。我们听到很多关于很多人只是参与者，为了乐趣而跑。

segments.en: But for you, this is a competitive thing for you.
segments.zh: 但对你来说，这是竞争性的事情。

segments.en: Tell me about your strategy when you're running and when you realize you have a lot of energy.
segments.zh: 告诉我你的策略，当你跑步时，当你意识到自己有很多能量时。

segments.en: It's like, OK, time to turn it up. Yeah, so I come from track running, like 5,000 meters, 10,000 meters.
segments.zh: 就像，好了，是时候加速了。是的，我来自田径项目，比如5000米、10000米。

segments.en: So I know that I probably have more finishing speed than most of the other pure marathon runners.
segments.zh: 所以我知道，我可能比大多数纯马拉松选手有更强的冲刺速度。

segments.en: So in my mind, I wanted it to be quite slow in the beginning, because I know that I'm going to be the fastest guy in the end.
segments.zh: 所以在我心里，我希望一开始跑得相当慢，因为我知道我最终会是最快的那个人。

segments.en: So my strategy was basically let the other guys do the work.
segments.zh: 所以我的策略基本上是让其他人去领跑。

segments.en: I'm not going to do anything, try to conserve as much energy as possible.
segments.zh: 我不做任何多余的事，尽量保存体力。
